text: Chapter 11: Off to Toram@Land of the Unknown
You were thrown off the ark, but you somehow managed to\nreach the mainland of Toram. Take Anono with you and\nstart walking around to check out what kind of world it is!
There are signs of something in the water and between the\ntrees in the forest. Walk through the forest while defeating\nthe monsters that are unique to this world!
Defeat Rhinoceros, an aggressive monster that attacks by\ncharging at its target!
Proceed to the depths of the Fugitive Lake Swamp that\ngives off an eerie atmosphere to check if there is anything!
There is a Coenubia monster, Gemma, in the depths of the\nFugitive Lake Swamp. Although getting weaker, it seems to\nstill have the strength to fight. Stay focused and beat it!
